moderate.name: Moderate steady rain (20 mm/h x 2 h)
moderate.description: 20 mm/h for 120 min then dry. SYNTHETIC design storm.

provenance.note: design-style constant storm, invented for testing; not an observed event

heavy.name: Heavy steady rain (50 mm/h x 2 h)
heavy.description: 50 mm/h for 120 min then dry. SYNTHETIC design storm.

provenance.note: design-style constant storm, invented for testing; not an observed event

cloudburst.name: Cloudburst pulse (peak 120 mm/h)
cloudburst.description: Gaussian pulse, peak 120 mm/h at 45 min, sigma 15 min. SYNTHETIC stress test.

provenance.note: Gaussian pulse peak 120 mm/h, sigma 15 min, centred at 45 min; invented stress test

july2005.name: 26 July 2005 replay (Santacruz gauge, hourly)
july2005.description: Peak 3 hours (14.30-17.30 IST) of the 26 July 2005 storm as measured at IMD Santacruz, transcribed from Chitale Committee report sec. 2.9.6. Hourly gauge values; total 380.8 mm.

provenance.source: Chitale Committee report (Fact Finding Committee on Mumbai Floods), section 2.9.6
provenance.note: IMD Santacruz manual measurement, 26 July 2005; peak 3-h window 14.30-17.30 IST = 100.2, 190.3, 90.3 mm; hourly resolution only (held constant within each hour); Santacruz is ~10 km north of the Dadar pilot - local intensity at the pilot is not known
